{{Top|leg}}
'''Prefsbelt Black''' was a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] orbiting [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] and part of the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Naval Academy]]. After graduating, newly-commissioned [[Midshipman/Legends|Midshipmen]] would ascend Prefsbelt Black, where they would receive their deployment orders and assignments to [[Warship/Legends|warships]].
